# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in groovy-check, please report it responsibly.

**Email**: aviadshiber@gmail.com

Please include:
- Description of the vulnerability
- Steps to reproduce
- Potential impact

You will receive an acknowledgment within 48 hours and a detailed response within 7 days.

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported |
|---------|-----------|
| Latest  | Yes       |

## Scope

This policy covers the `groovy-check` tool itself. It does not cover the
Jenkins server or npm-groovy-lint/CodeNarc, which groovy-check calls out to.
